admission.justification: The due claim spans the writer, the serving projection and the extracted bridge reader, and prevents the costly error of leaving a held seat until a deadline the host has already passed, or reading the same due report twice in one tick.

applicability: Every held-delivery tick while the limit file holds a live report whose next check is due.
conditions: A report is due when the later of its observedAt and its lastReadAttemptAt is at least five minutes old.

The tick claims the attempt and prunes expired provider-limit-suppressions.json entries under the same provider-limits.lock that writes the replacement, before the host call, including sidecar pruning in claim_due_reports change detection.
When periodic projection drops any live report covered by an active sidecar suppression, _periodic_update recomputes _updated_clear_markers so held work drains cleanly.
A due report is read through one eligible mapped seat that is still in the role record; a stamped-end read keeps its own observedAt and does not postpone a due periodic read.
exclusions: A report whose reset has passed and that no role mapping names.
A tick with no stamped end and no due report: that tick performs no usage read.
statement: The held-delivery tick rechecks each active unsuppressed limit after five minutes through one mapped seat with a persisted attempt time and forced refresh, while pruning expired sidecar entries and emitting clear markers when periodic projection drops a suppressed report.
title: Held-delivery tick rechecks due limits and prunes expired sidecar entries
